payment-gateway-bot: Chargeback received: CHB_2026_8271
payment-gateway-bot: Card network reason: "Unauthorized" (R85). Dispute amount: $12,384.50. Merchant descriptor: Redwood Inference - hosted-api

Samir (Finance Ops): tagging @Lena @Franklin @Micah. We just received a chargeback for acct acct_9ab3, invoice inv_2026_03_88. Needs dispute evidence within 30 days. :rotating_light:

Lena (Support): ack. Can you paste the transaction id and date? I need to pull the customer logs.

Samir (Finance Ops): Txn ID: txn_6f5e3a. Card last4: 4242. Posted date: 2026-03-16 18:12:03 UTC. Charge amount: $12,384.50. Dispute received 2026-03-28.

Franklin (Security): initial flag: multiple API keys seen from same billing account with different emails and rapid provisioning. Possible account takeover or friendly fraud. I'll triage IPs.

Lena (Support): pulling usage now. Quick heads-up: customer is on Dedicated plan, several subaccounts. Need permission to include hashed user IDs in evidence packet. Any PI constraints? @Samir

Samir (Finance Ops): ok to include hashed IDs + request IDs + timestamps. Do NOT include full card data or email addresses. Legal wants pseudonymized logs only.

Micah (CS): I've reached out to the customer contact (contact@acme.example). They say charges are unexpected and will not cooperate unless we provide proof of activity. Suggest we compile: invoice, signed TOS link, API call logs, streaming session IDs, and IP addresses (hashed).

Lena (Support): here's a quick excerpt of the activity around the disputed charge (pseudonymized):

```
account_id,request_id,timestamp,endpoint,seq_len,ip_hash
acct_9ab3,req_8732,2026-03-16T18:10:22Z,/v1/generate,1024,hash:3a5f...
acct_9ab3,req_8733,2026-03-16T18:11:05Z,/v1/generate,512,hash:3a5f...
acct_9ab3,req_8734,2026-03-16T18:12:01Z,/v1/embeddings,2048,hash:8b2c...
```

Lena (Support): total tokens matched invoice lines: 4,112, billed rounds to $12,384.50 per billing calc.

Franklin (Security): IP hash 3a5f maps to two distinct IPs in last 7 days from different countries. Looks like credential stuffing. Also seeing two API keys created inside 5 minutes on 3/16.

Samir (Finance Ops): We need to prepare a card network representment. Deadline to submit is 7 days from dispute received (2026-04-04). @Lena assemble docs: signed invoice PDF, pseudonymized logs, TOS snapshot, and support responses. @Franklin include risk findings summary.

Micah (CS): I'll draft the customer-facing summary. Do we want to try an outreach before disputing? Risk says probable fraud so better to dispute and provide evidence.

Lena (Support): attaching evidence bundle to this thread: S3 link: https://s3.redwood/internal/evidence/CHB_2026_8271.zip (access restricted). Note: bundle includes redacted IPs and hashed IDs.

Samir (Finance Ops): thanks. I'm preparing the representment letter. Quick Q: do we have video proof or signed SSO logs? Any MFA logs? @Franklin

Franklin (Security): Yes — SSO provider shows logins from two new devices with no prior history within 3 minutes of account creation. MFA was not enabled. Adding that to the packet.

Samir (Finance Ops): Good. Action items:
- @Lena: submit evidence bundle to processor and send representment packet by 2026-04-03.
- @Franklin: include risk timeline and SSO logs.
- @Micah: contact customer with redacted activity summary.

Micah (CS): will do. I'll include offer for credit/review if representment fails.

Lena (Support): submitted evidence to processor portal. Confirmation ID: RB-REP-4992. PDF and CSV uploaded.

payment-gateway-bot: Representment submitted successfully: RB-REP-4992. Next update from card network expected in 7–45 days.

Samir (Finance Ops): closing loop here — thanks everyone. If network rules in favor of cardholder we'll need to process refund and flag account for termination. :white_check_mark:

Franklin (Security): I'll put a hold on the account and rotate all active API keys pending review.

Lena (Support): copy. I'll follow up with any processor feedback and file this under finance/disputes.

Micah (CS): noted. Leaving final note for customer touchpoint. Thanks team :pray:
